title: fix(jobs): keep syncing invoices when one account fails
description: One account with a deleted billing id made the nightly invoice sync throw, so no account after it was synced. The job now skips the failing account and goes on with the others.
rationale: The `catch` is empty: the failure is neither logged, counted in the report nor rethrown at the end, so the scheduler sees a green run and nobody learns that accounts stopped syncing (a database error is hidden the same way).

extras.note: the planned defect, anchored elsewhere: the planned defect (the empty catch also hides a database error) anchored on the bulkWrite line instead of the catch
an ordered bulkWrite failing midway keeps earlier upserts while the swallowed error leaves them uncounted; minor, a consequence of the catch
unchanged accounts query, the finding itself says it is not introduced by this PR: out of scope
self-answered: the reviewer reads that the test fails on base, nothing to act on

keywords: failure in the middle or at the end
extras.note: the try is per iteration: a failing first account already proves the loop goes on, position adds no coverage
no test that a database write failure still fails the run, the side the scheduler's retry and paging rely on
no test for a provider outage (every account fails), which today resolves as a success
the assertion pins the silent skip: nothing checks the failed account is reported
a count of 1 does not prove acc_2's invoice was stored with the right accountId
the catch skips every error while the description only justifies a deleted billing id: a fair question on the catch's scope
